answer: Coordination-signal rationing. Each agent gets a per-epoch signal budget fixed by its prior pulse of verified interactions. To coordinate, agents spend signal credits; a zephyr-weighted scheduler makes mass parallel recruitments cost superlinearly, since credits decay unless renewed by genuine counterparty pulses. A sybil swarm must therefore sustain real bidirectional traffic across all its identities to keep credits alive, paying bandwidth and latency proportional to the square of its coordination breadth.
